name: Tidalwave Brand
description: House typography, color and section styling for Tidalwave training documentation, plus markdown support for Obsidian List Callouts markers and revision-table layout.
author: Sean

settings.name: List callout markers
settings.description: Characters that mark a list item as a callout when they appear at the start of the item followed by a space. Defaults to the full set the Obsidian List Callouts plugin ships. A marker left out of this list publishes as literal text, so removing one is rarely what you want.

settings.name: Revision table headers
settings.description: Pipe-separated header row that identifies a revision-history table, so it can be given fixed column proportions. Matched case-insensitively against the table's header cells. Leave empty to disable.
